customManagers.description: The Filament desktop SDK tag the compositor builds against. No built-in manager sees it: it is a plain string in a composite action's input default and in build.sh, not a dependency in any manifest — so without this it would never be offered an update at all, and this repository exists to build against exactly that SDK. Keyed off a `# renovate:` marker comment rather than the surrounding syntax, so the two sites can be written naturally and a third can opt in with one line.

packageRules.description: Never automerge Filament, overriding the shared preset's minor/patch automerge. This component's failure mode is a subtly wrong or empty image, not a crash: the serve smoke proves the renderer still produces a DIFFERENT image when a panel moves, which a graphics SDK bump can pass while quietly changing what everything looks like. A human compares the render.
